# Module M3 · Viewing

## 1. Learning objectives

- Create, query and drop views; explain why they cost almost no space and stay current
- Use views to simplify (hide joins), aggregate (and build views on views), partition and secure
- Choose between VIEW, TEMPORARY VIEW and CTE by lifetime
- Make a read-only view writable with INSTEAD OF triggers, including conditional (WHEN) triggers

## 6. Common mistakes

- **C3.1**: thinking a view stores a copy of the data
- **C3.2**: dropping key columns you'll later need for joins (L502-510)
- **C3.3**: expecting it to need refreshing (it is always current)
- **C3.4**: relying on it in a later session
- **C3.5**: a trailing comma after the last CTE
- **C3.6**: numeric-looking names need quotes; ambiguous names
- **C3.7**: SQLite cannot stop anyone reading the base table (no access control)
- **C3.8**: forgetting the WHERE inside the trigger (updates every row); needing two INSERT triggers (exists / not exists)
